methodologyNotes: Covers standalone consumer and small-office UPS battery backup units sold at a published US MSRP/typical price in USD. Excludes bare replacement battery cartridges, whole-home battery/solar systems, portable power stations, and pure surge strips without a battery. topology is an enum (standby, line-interactive, online-double-conversion) per the manufacturer spec sheet. capacityVa is rated apparent power in volt-amps (VA). outputWatts is rated real/active power in watts (W). waveform is the on-battery output shape as an enum (pure-sine, simulated-sine, stepped-approximation). batteryBackupOutlets is the count of receptacles fed by the battery during an outage (excludes surge-only receptacles). batteryType is an enum (sealed-lead-acid, lithium-ion, lifepo4). runtimeHalfLoadMin is manufacturer-rated runtime in minutes at 50% of rated load; null if not disclosed. rechargeTimeHrs is the typical recharge-to-90-percent time in hours; null if not disclosed. surgeProtectionJoules is the surge energy dissipation rating in joules (J); null if not disclosed. hasLcdDisplay is a boolean for a multi-line status LCD/segment display. formFactor is an enum (tower, rackmount, rack-tower-convertible, compact). weightKg is unit weight in kilograms.
